name: The Love Of Money
overview: Scripture warns against the love of money as a root of dissatisfaction and spiritual danger, teaching that wealth gained without honest labor is fleeting, and an insatiable desire for silver or abundance leads to vanity. Jesus clearly states that no one can serve both God and mammon, highlighting the impossibility of divided allegiance. Believers are exhorted to guard against covetousness, recognizing that true life is not found in possessions, but in contentment grounded in God's faithful presence and provision.
